posts.title: Tinycast, a new macOS Spotlight alternative on steroids
posts.description: Learn about Tinycast as Spotlight alternative - first setup, settings, use cases with app launcher, timezone conversation and emoji search. Migration and dotfiles automation included.

posts.title: Recharging batteries at 1500m: Vigilius mountain resort in South Tyrol
posts.description: Unplugging in busy AI times is not easy. I found a unique spot in South Tyrol, only reachable by cable car, with scenic views over the dolomites, hiking, spa treatments, high quality food, and kind humans - to recharge my batteries.

posts.title: Building an Interactive Conference Badge with Tufty 2040: A Step-by-Step Guide
posts.description: At tech conferences, your badge is the first impression. The Tufty 2040 LCD Display badge can serve as a dynamic contact card with QR codes, making it a business card. Learn how wave and PCB animations were added for playful engagement, and how to build your own badge.
